name: Ame de wa Naku, Yuki de Naku
source:
Sato is in charge of network management for insurance companies. His cousin and childhood friend Miyuki calls him with words "I'm getting married..." 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Sato在保險公司擔任網管。他的表親兼青梅竹馬Miyuki打電話告訴他：「我要結婚了……」

（來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]）
